content: Spring Cloud AWS (awspring.io, community-maintained successor to the old Spring Cloud AWS) provides SqsTemplate and @SqsListener abstractions over AWS SDK v2 for SQS. Version compatibility is train-locked: Spring Cloud AWS 3.0.x pairs with Spring Boot 3.0/3.1, 3.1.x pairs with Boot 3.2; must match the Spring Cloud AWS minor to the Spring Boot minor via the compatibility matrix in awspring.io docs.
